@jobname These jobs run last business day of the week
but NOT when the last business day of the week
and last business day of the month fall on the same
%jobname These jobs run last business day of the month
You will see that wherever there is a @jobname on the flow
QR cxnwpbmsmz is set to 0 by job
cxnwpbmsmz which runs L1, NATXHOL (ie. when
monthly PB rolls in). It is set to 1 by job cxnwpbmsm1
which runs after nwpbmsmz (monthly PB) completes.
This ensures that monthly PB completes before
